mapper.select: INSERT INTO queue_tickets ( health_center_id, visit_id, service_type_id, ticket_number, status, issued_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{healthCenterId}, #{visitId}, #{serviceTypeId}, ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(q.ticket_number), 0) + 1 FROM queue_tickets q WHERE q.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND q.service_type_id = #{serviceTypeId} AND q.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE ), 'WAITING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING id, ticket_number, status
